notes.text:
Available from cPanel & WHM 56. This function lists all available cPanel Market products from enabled providers,
with the prices that the adjustments database modifies.
Returned provider content, icons, schemas, attributes and URLs are payload data; the client does not render, execute or fetch them. Every call makes one request without retry or rollback.

Adjusted prices use number values and product_id is an integer. Preserve explicit null prices, nullable max_users and category, omitted fields and dynamic provider-specific extra values separately. Extra-value contents remain opaque.

notes.text:
Available from cPanel & WHM 56. This function lists all available cPanel Market providers' products and the attributes of each product that can be managed by an administrator. The return list includes different `attribute` data depending the `product_group` for each product.
Product Group Attributes Returned Description
ssl_certificate SSLMarketProviderMetaData Contains additional attributes only applicable to SSL Certificates
* MarketProviderMetaData Any products not in a product_group listed above will include only these attributes.
**Note:** The function does **not** return the `product_group` name. To get the `product_group` name for a `product_id`, run WHM API 1's [`get_market_providers_products`](https://go.cpanel.net/Market-get-market-providers-products) function.
Returned provider content, icons, schemas, attributes and URLs are payload data; the client does not render, execute or fetch them. Every call makes one request without retry or rollback.

The attributes object combines base-product and SSL-product metadata without dropping SSL-only optional fields. Each read_only value is an integer 0|1 flag. product_group is not returned by this operation; consult getProvidersProducts() when needed.

notes.text: Available from cPanel & WHM 56. This function sets an attribute for a cPanel Market provider's product.
Returned provider content, icons, schemas, attributes and URLs are payload data; the client does not render, execute or fetch them. Every call makes one request without retry or rollback.
The pinned response documents metadata only and no data payload; this method returns void. Inspect responseMeta() for the WHM outcome.

Attribute names and values vary by provider and product. Values remain caller-supplied strings, including empty and zero strings, and are sensitive because they can contain provider credentials. This method changes the selected product attribute immediately without retry.

notes.text: Available from cPanel & WHM 56. This function sets the contact ID to which a cPanel Market provider will send commission.
